reference.title: API Database
reference.shortdesc: The proprietary ADI OtoSense™ predictive maintenance analytics uses the API database to update the user

section.p: The proprietary ADI OtoSense™ predictive maintenance analytics uses the API database to update the user on key motor performance metrics. These include the power system, stator winding, rotor, motor shaft or balance, eccentricity, bearing, alignment, cooling system, loose foot, and overall motor performance.
The REST APIs for the OtoSense™ SMS device provide seamless integration with the device sensors, enabling users to gather, update, and delete the following data:

row.entry: A motor ID, a list of motors, and motor records
A sensor ID, a list of sensors, and sensor records
The vibrations of the motor are monitored using a Vibration X-axis and a Vibration Z-axis sensor
The magnetic field around a motor is monitored using a magnetic field sensor
The temperature outside a motor is monitored using a motor temperature sensor and an environment temperature sensor

section.p: For more information on the predictive maintenance analytics and the API database, see the Analytics User Guide.
